geometric_operations: roll rotation about cylinder image center using warpAffine
generator_source_contract.pose_sampling: searchsorted first IMU timestamp at or after (frame_index + configured offset)*1000/30; clipped at ends

optical_flow_source_contract.path: cumulative sum of per-frame translation and angle
optical_flow_source_contract.smoothing: centered 61-tap Gaussian radius30, sigma15 frames; edge padding
optical_flow_source_contract.application: two-pass offline processing, warp stored panorama, output MP4V at30fps
optical_flow_source_contract.latency_scope: uses future frames; not an online latency benchmark
optical_flow_source_contract.scope: specific archived global-rigid comparator, not all optical-flow/global stabilization methods

provenance_limits: gen_log.txt and of_log.txt describe2534x540 four-camera outputs, not the1900x540 three-view clips evaluated in cam3_* subdirectories.
Exact generation command transcripts and frozen generator versions for the selected three-view clips were not located.

The generator source uses floating-point geometry, quarter-degree pose quantization, sequential warpAffine and horizontal strip concatenation; this differs from the current FPGA fixed-point maps, interpolation and seam blending.
Video/frame metric recomputation establishes values on the hashed saved outputs; it does not establish exact regeneration from raw sensor recordings or FPGA execution.
find_segment.py explicitly searches windows based on motion and image/IMU correlation; archived windows cannot be presented as preregistered or randomly sampled.
compile_stab_excel.py embeds rounded result constants and interpretive prose. Recomputations must use the underlying clips/IMU, not treat those constants as independent logs.
